_why: Files whose change alters how code is tested, merged or deployed (LC-2207). A PR that changes one needs an LCH-600 review first. Globs are fnmatch: * also matches /. Edit this file, not the hook. `gate`: a change here needs review. `new_ok`: a brand-new file here passes when its rule holds (dispatch_only: the workflow's `on:` has only workflow_dispatch / workflow_call). `append_ok`: a changed file here passes when its rule holds (lines: only added lines; selftest_block: only comments, blanks and `run_one <name> \` blocks; json_grow: each `grow` list (dotted path) only gained entries and every other key is unchanged, so tier0, max_files and the rest stay frozen). `derived`: a generated file passes when its generator is unchanged (its inputs are judged on their own, and `quick` refuses a hand edit). Rules shaped by LCH-600 review on LC-2207.
_mode: shadow = warn and toast `SHADOW would-deny`, never block. enforce = deny. Shadow ends on shadow_until: the selftest fails after that date while mode is still shadow, so the decision cannot be forgotten. Enforce bar: in the week's replay (python3 lch600-review-gate.py --replay --since 2026-11-17), at most 1 would-deny that a reviewer judges a false alarm.
_plan: LCH-744 (operator decision 2026-11-19: no build without the building permit, enforced from day one, no shadow week): plan-stage half, hooks/plan_stage.py. An edit of a file this list would review (minus new_ok, append_ok and derived paths) is denied until the ci-speed desk has approved the session's PLAN (board verdict accepted or ship_after_fixes, or Jira request plus LCH-600 feedback, or a stated Skipping LCH-600 review). enforce = deny; shadow = kill switch short of disabling the mod (one note per session, selftest fails after shadow_until).
